title: Hussain Bismillah
body:
Mustafa Keh Rahe Hain.
Murtaza Keh Rahe Hain.
<<DIVIDER>>
Osiya Keh Rahe Hain.
Anbiya Keh Rahe Hain.
<<DIVIDER>>
Keh Raha Hai Yehi Khana-e-Kibriya.
Zameen Pe Aaiye Maula.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hain Intezar Mein Zahra.
Zameen Ke Zarron Ko Sadrash Ke Toor Kar Maula.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Aaj Teesri Shabaan Zahoor Kar Maula.
Pukarta Hai Madina Hussain Bismillah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Bacha Lo Qehar Se Mar Jaye Ga Yeh Bechara.
Paron Ko Dekh Ke Fitrus Ke Mustafa Ne Kaha.
<<DIVIDER>>
Mareez Hai Yeh Tumhara Hussain Bismillah.
Hussain La Se Hai Deta Daleel Illallah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain Khon-e-Ali Hai Hussain Sarallah.
Hussain Soroon Ka Sorah Hussain Bismillah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Tamam Anbiya Zainab Ki Kar Rahe They Sana.
Woh Sare Thak Gaye Jab Phir Yeh Fatima Ne Kaha.
<<DIVIDER>>
Parho Behan Ka Qaseeda Hussain Bismillah.
Nikal Ke Ran Mein Pukari Yeh Zulfiqar-e-Ali.
<<DIVIDER>>
Dikha Do Aaj Zamane Ko Ikhteyar-e-Ali.
Badal Do Jang Ka Naqsha Hussain Bismillah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zaban Band Ho Sab Ki Jo Meri Baat Khulay.
Mere Bhi Qalb Pe Raz-e-Muqateaat Khulay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Parha Dein Bas Mujhe Maula Hussain Bismillah.
Yeh Hath Mar Ke Seene Pe Matami Ne Kaha.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghareeb Khane Mein Tashreef Laiye Maula.
Khula Hai Dil Ka Dareecha Hussain Bismillah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Na Ro Habib Ki Madar Kareem Hai Maula.
Abhi Yeh Dekhna Al-Hamd Parhta Uthay Ga.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Iss Se Aa Ke Kahey Ga Hussain Bismillah.
Yeh Murtajiz Ne Kaha Chor Kar Na Jaon Ga.
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasam Saeed Ki Main Sare Teer Khaon Ga.
Karo Tum Aakhri Sajdah Hussain Bismillah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh Baat Karb-o-Bala Aa Ke Zahra Bolein Gi.
Jahan Niyam Mein Talwar Tum Ne Rakhi Thi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Wahin Se Phir Karo Hamla Hussain Bismillah.
Yeh Hadisoon Se Hamesha Tumhein Bachaye Ga.
<<DIVIDER>>
Laga Lo Ghar Pe :TAKALLUM: Yeh Kam Aaye Ga.
Bara Hasen Hai Togra Hussain Bismillah.
author: Mir Hassan Mir
